title: OL-20261115-17: workers#75 GATE: start Ultrastable on Ultrastable (owner steps)
body:
**Owner:** ROWAN (identity-bound)
**Trigger:** any one door done
**Done check:** file:org/started.json
**Status:** closed

Moved from ultrastable/workers#75. Owner steps: a Cloudflare door (sign-in, launcher, git import or scoped token), GITHUB_TOKEN, a model key, a spending approval, the org admin token. Default in effect: dry run, nothing spent; reference tenants keep ticking on the old account. Closing probe file_exists:org/started.json.

**Disposition:** gate (owner-bound, 2026-11-20T20:46:50Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** owner field 'ROWAN (identity-bound)' binds this to the owner's own account, money or signature, which no server-side loop holds. Default in effect: the system runs without this step; nothing waits on it. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes.
